Weakest cell drives String 1 · M2 cell 7. LEM split = % of pack current through LEM A (strings 1+2). Low cut is a what-if: at 3.30 V the mains open before the 3.2 V sag derate can start. Sliders are shared with the Pack tab.

BMS_CAP_KELLY_LIMIT_DRV=0 and TELEMETRY_ONLY=1: the Teensy only prints these. The Kelly's CAN is broadcast-only, so cutback has to go through its digital inputs and throttle line.

Wiring design KELLY SIDE UNVERIFIED

    
    
      
  1. Limp. OUT3 (Teensy pin 20) drives a PC817 opto whose transistor pulls the KLS low-speed switch input to its RTN. Max speed in limp is set in the Kelly config tool and caps speed, not battery amps. KLS pin number: read it off Adam's harness or the KLS manual.
    2. 
      
  2. Derate. OUT5 (pin 2) PWM, duty = allowance %. Planned: RC filter to a DC level that scales the throttle wiper (CD4066 analog switch or MCP4131 digital pot). Part choice and values not picked yet.
    3. 
      
  3. Regen. OUT6 (pin 3) HIGH = regen allowed, through a PC817 in series with the KLS regen or brake-switch input. Which KLS input does regen on this controller is unverified.
    4. 
      
  4. Hard stop. Real faults still open the EV200 mains through the contactor sequence; cutback is the soft layer in front of that.
    5. 
    

    
Full notes: docs/KELLY_CUTBACK.md.
